item.title: Version 0.1.0
item.description:
GitPilot v0.1.0

The first release. A macOS menu bar app that watches your GitHub PRs and pings you the moment one needs attention — behind the base branch, ready to merge, or blocked by failing CI. Click the notification's Rebase button and GitPilot calls GitHub's updatePullRequestBranch GraphQL mutation directly. Same effect as picking "Update with rebase" from the dropdown on the PR page, without leaving your current task.

Install

Apple Silicon Mac on macOS 13 or later:

curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/benjamingarcia10/GitPilot/main/scripts/install.sh | bash

The installer downloads the signed zip, verifies the SHA-256, installs to /Applications, and launches the app. No Gatekeeper "Open Anyway" detour — curl-downloaded files don't carry the quarantine attribute that browser downloads do.

After install: allow notification permission on first launch, then brew install gh && gh auth login.

Highlights

  • Menu bar surface — status glyph swaps between checkmark (ready), circular arrows (behind), triangle (conflicts), lock (blocked), and the default PR glyph. Attention-count badge shows how many PRs are actionable.
  • Four tabs — My PRs · Reviewing · Activity · Worktrees. Reviewer pills show why you're on the list (you or @team-slug).
  • One-click rebase — Notification's Rebase button calls updatePullRequestBranch directly, no PR page detour.
  • Auto-rebase and auto-merge per PR — opt in where you want it, manual control everywhere else. Auto-merge falls back to client-side merging when the repo doesn't allow GitHub-native auto-merge.
  • Edge-triggered notifications — one fire per state transition, deduped across app restarts. Ten event types, all toggleable in Settings.
  • Pin / snooze — pin to focus only on those PRs (notifications scope to the pinned set); snooze for 30m / 2h / until tomorrow 9am.
  • Worktree manager — create per-PR worktrees under ~/worktrees/gitpilot, open in your editor, remove when done. Refuses to nuke dirty worktrees without confirmation.
  • Inline check list — every CI check or status context with deep links (Buildkite, GitHub Actions, CircleCI, etc.).
  • Search bar with regex toggle, repo filter, and 5 sort orders. All persisted across launches.
  • Activity log — chronological view of every state transition, action you took, and failure (capped at 200 entries / 7 days). Selectable for copy, full text on hover.
  • Auto-update via Sparkle — every release after this one installs in-app, ed25519-signature-verified.

Settings

Open with ⌘,. Four tabs:

  • General — poll interval (10s–5m), sort order, worktree root, editor (auto-detects Cursor → VSCode → Sublime).
  • Notifications — every notification toggle and a Send test notification button.
  • Repos — per-repo auto-merge method overrides (Squash / Merge / Rebase).
  • Updates — manual Check for Updates… button, last-checked timestamp, auto-check toggle.

Requirements

  • macOS 13 (Ventura) or later
  • Apple Silicon (arm64) — Intel builds aren't shipped today
  • gh authenticated: gh auth login

Notes

  • Ad-hoc code-signed (no paid Apple Developer ID). The curl | bash installer is the friction-free path. If you install manually from the zip below, macOS will block the first launch with "Apple cannot check it for malicious software" — open System Settings → Privacy & Security and click Open Anyway. Only the first launch is affected.
  • No telemetry. All state lives at ~/Library/Application Support/GitPilot/state.json.
  • GitHub auth via the gh CLI. Tokens never leave your machine; the app reads them from gh auth token on demand.

See the README for the full feature inventory and architecture notes.
